title: Titanium Dental Implant Fixture
alloyReason: Grade 4 CP-Ti (UNS R50700) is used for Titanium Dental Implant Fixture where maximum CP-grade strength (550 MPa tensile) is required while retaining the excellent corrosion resistance and biocompatibility characteristic of commercially pure titanium. Higher oxygen content (0.40% max) provides solid-solution strengthening without compromising the stable passivation behavior needed for Endosseous dental implant fixture screw (Grade 4). This rationale is driven by endosseous dental implant fixture screw (grade 4) and service environment demands.
process: CNC swiss turning for dental geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for endosseous dental implant application
commonFailures: Fe contamination from machining - requires acid passivation 20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C per ASTM F86 — critical for endosseous dental implant performance

faq.q: Is Titanium Dental Implant Fixture MRI-safe or MRI-conditional?
faq.a: Grade 4 CP-Ti is non-ferromagnetic (magnetic susceptibility 1.00005 × 10⁻⁶ cgs) and generates negligible MRI artifact compared to 316L stainless steel. Titanium Dental Implant Fixture is classified as MR-Conditional under ASTM F2052/F2213 testing at 1.5T and 3.0T field strengths. Specific absorption rates remain within safe limits for endosseous dental implant configurations.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Dental Implant Fixture orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Dental Implant Fixture is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Dental Implant Fixture?
faq.a: Each Titanium Dental Implant Fixture shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for endosseous dental implant.
